title: Split-penalized softened crossing covers give an eventual 4.88325 N gate lower bound

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. claims: For every simple cubic graph on n vertices, under the four-level star cost (0, 1, 1 + 41/20000, 27/50), if all prefixes of a nested single-vertex anchor ordering have generalized anchor cost at most M, then its edge cutwidth is at most M + o(n) with exact unit layout factor R = 1, uniformly over graphs and anchor orderings.

On any finite cubic graph H' whose crossing subgraph has maximum degree at most two, with simultaneous odd-path switches governed by the pairwise-disjoint (OUT, V_odd) guard partition and selective noncrossing flips incident to S = S_1 U S_2, the generalized star cost satisfies Q_{lambda,delta}(b, x) <= (1 - delta)|K| + delta|E_cross(H')| - (1 - lambda - 2*delta)|S_1| - (1 - lambda)|S_2| pointwise.

experiments.purpose: Certify U and W_1 by outward-rounded quadrature, verify exact R=1 algebraic inequalities at (lambda, delta) = (27/50, 41/20000), replay the four disjoint cavity saving integrals by integer log-concave and Holder-compressed quadrature, and compare the resulting gate coefficient with 19533/4000 by exact fractions.
